def test_monotonic():
    # Increasing sequences
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 4, 20]) == True
    assert monotonic([1, 20, 4, 10]) == False

    # Decreasing sequences
    assert monotonic([4, 1, 1, 0, -10]) == True
    assert monotonic([1, 1, 1, 1]) == True  # Equal elements are both increasing and decreasing

    # Mixed (non-monotonic)
    assert monotonic([5, 3, 4, 2]) == False
    assert monotonic([1, 3, 2, 4]) == False

    # Edge cases
    assert monotonic([]) == True          # Empty list is trivially monotonic
    assert monotonic([7]) == True         # Single element is trivially monotonic
    assert monotonic([2, 2, 2, 2]) == True  # All equal values
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 2, 3]) == True  # Non-decreasing with duplicates
    assert monotonic([5, 5, 4, 3]) == True  # Non-increasing with duplicates
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 3, 2]) == False # Increase then decrease
    assert monotonic([-1, -2, -3]) == True  # Negative numbers decreasing
    assert monotonic([-3, -2, -1]) == True  # Negative numbers increasing
    assert monotonic([3.5, 2.1, 1.0]) == True  # Floats decreasing
    assert monotonic([0, 0, -1, -2]) == True   # Zero with negatives

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_monotonic()

# Unit test for function monotonic
def test_monotonic():
    # Strictly increasing
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 4, 20]) == True
    # Strictly decreasing
    assert monotonic([4, 1, 0, -10]) == True
    # Not monotonic
    assert monotonic([1, 20, 4, 10]) == False
    # All equal elements (both non-increasing and non-decreasing)
    assert monotonic([7, 7, 7]) == True
    # Single element
    assert monotonic([5]) == True
    # Empty list
    assert monotonic([]) == True
    # Non-strict monotonic with duplicates
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 2, 3]) == True
    assert monotonic([5, 4, 4, 2]) == True
    # Duplicates break neither direction check incorrectly
    assert monotonic([1, 2, 2, 1]) == False
    # Two elements
    assert monotonic([1, 2]) == True
    assert monotonic([2, 1]) == True
    # Negative numbers
    assert monotonic([-3, -2, -1]) == True
    assert monotonic([-1, -2, -3]) == True
    # Floats
    assert monotonic([1.5, 2.5, 3.5]) == True
    assert monotonic([3.5, 2.5, 3.0]) == False
    # Mixed int/float
    assert monotonic([1, 1.5, 2]) == True
